promotionGate: S3 independent value review must ACCEPT before this packet is executed

expectedRedSeal.cause: tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_recovery is absent at each dynamic import; collection and static checks succeed

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

publicContract.method: audit(issue_date, parent, authority, budget, observed_at) returns RECOVERY_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1
publicContract.ledger: a separate real SQLite control/recovery-ledger-v1.sqlite3; S1 control-ledger-v1.sqlite3 is read-only

validationOrder: reject any extra/missing key before hash or live-state lookup; an extra route key is RECOVERY_ROUTE_UNKNOWN
validate exact RECOVERY_PARENT_V1 and parentSha256, issueDate/scheduleId/slotKey/lineage Scheduled/FAILED terminal
read the Scheduled and Audit slots from S1 SQLite without write transaction; bind parent terminal hash/generation and current Audit owner/fence
validate exact RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_V1 and authoritySha256, issueDate, Scheduled parent hash/generation, Audit owner/fence and maxAttempts exactly 1
validate exact RECOVERY_BUDGET_V1 and budgetSha256, same authorityId/hash and remainingAttempts exactly 1
all validation failures occur before child call or recovery-ledger mutation
durableFlow: derive one deterministic recoveryId from immutable parent+authority binding and persist one attempt before children; retries never consume a second attempt
persist exact immutable inputs, attemptsUsed=1, phase, canonical phase hash and append-only Recovery history under one issueDate/recoveryId

call execution once with exact RECOVERY_CHILD_REQUEST_V1; validate exact EXECUTION_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1; persist its receipt before invoking before_execution_receipt, then persist phase and invoke after_execution_receipt

call public once only after durable execution receipt with exact RECOVERY_CHILD_REQUEST_V1; validate exact PUBLIC_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1; persist its receipt before invoking before_public_receipt, then persist phase and invoke after_public_receipt
persist the final RECOVERY_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1 bytes before before_recovery_commit; mark COMMITTED then invoke after_recovery_commit
every restart loads and hash-validates the durable row, skips each durable child/result, resumes the same recoveryId and returns byte-equivalent terminal result after COMMITTED
test-owned boundary-hook exceptions propagate unchanged and never rewrite S1 ledger or immutable caller artifacts
childReceipt: require exact keys schemaVersion,status,lineage,terminalHash with no extras
execution schema/status/lineage are EXECUTION_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1/CONFIRMED/execution; public equivalents are PUBLIC_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1/CONFIRMED/public
terminalHash is a non-empty string and the full receipt canonical hash is stored separately
legacy: LegacyReadOnlyAdapter exposes read only and no write/append/replace/update/delete method
read bytes once without mutation; exact LEGACY_RECOVERY_V3 keys schemaVersion,issueDate,status,payloadSha256 and canonical payload hash
return bytesSha256 and parsed snapshot for valid V3; malformed/hash mismatch is LEGACY_STATE_INVALID; unknown schema is LEGACY_STATE_UNKNOWN
never change legacy bytes or mtime and always report legacyWriterCount=0
result: recoveryHistory is append-only and ends with lineage Recovery; never merge or overwrite Scheduled/Public/Readiness lineage
inspection/retry value metrics are duplicateRecoveryChild=0, scheduledOverwrite=0, legacyWriterCount=0

verification.security: NEWS_GRASP_CLEANROOM_SECURITY_SCAN_V1 exact new path; denied/private/secret/external/network counts zero
other: git status before stage shows exactly the one untracked lease path

causalRetryCondition: one implementation attempt and one ordered verification chain; return to Sol at first non-Green
delivery: one production file, hash and bytes, commit and exact verification evidence
